brief: Classic 1940 Cape Cod: one and a half storeys, side-gabled with two gabled dormers, white clapboard, shutters, a centre door with a small pediment and neat evergreen plantings along a curving street.

facade.notes: (Middletown OH appraisal snapshot): a 1940 Cape Cod with a gabled dormer, shutters, columnar evergreens flanking the window, a lattice-sided entry porch, a white picket fence across the side yard; sidewalk, terrace and street trees
